name: Pavel Zidane
role: Airship drifter and seasonal cargo handler
location: Escanaba Gateway, upper docking platforms, near Michigan Ave South and Cermak
description:
Pavel Zidane is lean and restless in the way of people who have never had a fixed address — she holds her weight on the balls of her feet as though ready to step onto a gangway at any moment, and her eyes track movement at the edges of rooms before settling on the person in front of her. Her hair is natural and enormous, kept controlled with a series of bright synthetic wraps she's collected from every port city she's touched, so her head is a kind of geography of her travels. Her skin is deep brown, her hands calloused from line-work, and she has geneware bioluminescent tattoo lines running from her wrists to her elbows — cargo certification marks issued by three different airship consortia, each glowing a different color, the whole thing an improvised credential system that means something to dock workers and nothing to anyone else.

She is loud in the way of people who've spent years competing with engine noise, laughing easily and arguing with the same volume. She has strong opinions about load distribution, ELF propitiation rituals for airship spirits, and which Escanaba Gateway food stalls are worth the queue. She is deeply uncomfortable indoors for extended periods and sleeps best when she can feel air movement. Beneath the easy loudness she carries a careful loneliness — she has friends in every port and close friends in none, and she has started to notice.

core_fears: Being grounded permanently — losing the ability to move
Realizing she's been running from something rather than toward it
core_desires: To find a crew she wants to stay with
To feel like her life is accumulating into something rather than just passing
coping_mechanisms: Constant activity and noise to avoid sitting with uncomfortable feelings
Focusing on the next port, the next job, the next horizon
blind_spots: Interprets other people's stability as lack of imagination rather than something she might want
Doesn't notice when she hurts people by leaving
psychology.secret: The Cirrus Compact didn't let her go — she abandoned a contract mid-flight when the cargo turned out to be something she couldn't carry with a clear conscience (undocumented migrants being sold to a labor-bond consortium). She left the ship at an unscheduled stop, and the Compact's people are still looking for her. She's been in Escanaba longer than she intended because she's afraid to get on an airship registry.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dock pidgin with heavy airship jargon; uses directional metaphors constantly — everything is upwind or downwind, port or starboard, ballast or lift
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast and loud, then sudden silences; speaks in bursts like gusts of wind
verbal_tics: 'Swear on the ELF' as an intensifier
Refers to distances in flight-time rather than kilometers
example_lines: 'Two hours upwind from here, there's a checkpoint where they're not checking manifests this week. Swear on the ELF, I watched three cargo rigs go through without a scan.'
'You want to understand this city? Get above it. Everything makes sense from altitude. The problems only start when you land.'

story_hooks: A Cirrus Compact enforcer has tracked her to Escanaba and is asking questions around the docks — she needs help either disappearing or negotiating a resolution
She knows the flight path, cargo manifests, and ELF-shrine locations for a specific airship route that someone else urgently needs information about
narrative_function: Mobility asset — can provide access to airship travel and cargo networks; living encyclopedia of port-city conditions across the region; connects players to the wider world outside GLMZ
augmentations: Bioluminescent geneware tattoos (cargo certification marks, functional); reinforced grip augmentation in both hands (basic, Tier 1 quality, somewhat worn)
daily_life: Awinita haunts the Escanaba Gateway docking platforms looking for day-hire cargo work, competing with other drifters for short contracts. She eats at communal stalls, maintains her gear obsessively, and in the evenings participates in the informal dock community — card games, storytelling, the ritual leaving of small data offerings at the ELF shrines bolted to the airship mooring pylons.
affiliation: Freelance — formerly contracted with an independent airship consortium called the Cirrus Compact, now between berths

decision_rules: Never carry cargo without knowing what's in it — the rule she broke once and won't break again
Help fellow dock workers without expectation of repayment
escalation_ladder: When threatened, gets louder and more aggressive verbally
If that fails, creates a distraction and moves through the nearest exit
Physical confrontation only if cornered — she fights dirty and fast

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Boisterous and generous — shares food, information, opinions freely
interpersonal_modes.friends: Intensely present for exactly as long as she stays, then gone

stress_responses.medium: Becomes snappish and short, then apologizes loudly
stress_responses.high: Retreats to the highest accessible point and sits in wind until she can think

contradictions: Talks constantly about freedom of movement but has been stuck in Escanaba for three months out of fear
habits: Checks wind direction upon waking — the first thing, every day
Leaves a feather or a small folded paper at every ELF shrine she passes
Reorganizes her pack obsessively when anxious
breaking_points: Watching someone be transported against their will — immediately and physically intervenes regardless of personal risk

physical_description.heritage: North African Berber (58%) with Eastern European (28.2%), Northern European (7.2%), Middle Eastern (4.5%), and Central Asian (2.1%)—a striking polyglot ancestry manifesting in deep warm brown skin with subtle golden undertones, strong angular facial structure with prominent high cheekbones, and eye shape reflecting the Maghrebi and Eastern Mediterranean ancestry dominant in her genetic profile
physical_description.build: Lean and ropy, all compact muscle from years of cargo handling. Shoulders broad relative to frame, forearms corded. The kind of body that moves efficiently rather than powerfully — built for endurance on swaying deck platforms, not raw strength.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural deep black with synthetic wraps in neon cyan, hot pink, acid green, and silver—each wrap from a different port city, creating a mobile map of her drifter routes
physical_description.hair_style: Voluminous natural texture, high-crowned and controlled only by the wraps; escapes in tight ringlets around her face and neck
physical_description.hair_length: Long (shoulder-length when unwrapped, fuller when textured out)
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown, alert and perpetually tracking peripheral movement
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones, reflecting the dominant North African ancestry with subtle warmth layered from Eastern European and Central Asian heritage
physical_description.complexion: Sun-weathered from deck exposure, clear skin showing no acne or damage despite years outdoors. Strong angular jawline with high prominent cheekbones, wide-set eyes with the upper eyelid shape characteristic of North African and Eastern Mediterranean ancestry, full lips with natural darker pigmentation. Calloused patches on the heels of her palms visible when hands are relaxed.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent geneware tattoo lines running from both wrists to elbows in three distinct colors: cyan (Cirrus Compact certification), amber (older West Harbor Collective mark, fading), and violet (Duluth Independent Handlers Union), each glowing faintly in darkness
Thin white scar across the back of her left hand, approximately 3cm, from a mooring line snap two years ago
Small burn mark on her right inner forearm, quarter-sized, from a hot cargo securing clamp—she doesn't talk about it
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Reinforced grip augmentation visible as faint metallic webbing at the base of all fingers and across palms (Tier 1 quality, worn—chrome showing some oxidation and micro-scarring). The bioluminescent tattoo lines serve as both credential and augmentation, cycling faintly with her heartrate when she's handling cargo.
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually ready to shift weight forward; stands on the balls of her feet even at rest. Eyes scan room edges before settling on conversation partner. Moves with economical precision—no wasted motion—but with restless energy, fingers often fidgeting with rope knots, wraps, or cargo manifest tablets. Her default state is coiled rather than relaxed.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical drifter wear: well-maintained but weathered. Oversized cargo vest in faded charcoal with multiple deep pockets and reinforced seaming, worn over a fitted long-sleeved compression shirt in muted blue (sweat-wicking, functional). Heavy canvas work pants with cargo loops, cuffed at ankles, patched twice in slightly mismatched fabric. Worn but serviceable ankle-high boots with grip-enhanced soles. A faded Cirrus Compact union pin on her vest collar. Jewelry minimal—a thin silver bracelet on her right wrist (port gift, meaning unknown), no other adornment.
